{{Quote|All through your life, you fulfilled your duties with strength, grace, and honor, and we will remember. Only one duty remains. Go onward and break trail so that we may someday follow.|Izal Waz, giving Master Hamner's eulogy|<ref name="Conviction" />}}
In [[44 ABY]], a '''Jedi funeral''' took place to honor the recently [[Death/Legends|deceased]] acting [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]], [[Kenth Hamner]]. It was attended by all the members of the [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]], which consisted of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Haydnat Treen]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Merratt Jaxton]]. Some members of Hamner's family came as well as his friends from the military. Because he died in a fight, the [[Justice Department]] was debating whether this was a case of murder or not. Hamner's former apprentice, [[Izal Waz]], gave the eulogy and lit the funeral pyre of his late master.
